opening.argument: The speaker directly ties entry into the Mirror Trading International pool to immediate earnings, stating that participants can begin with at least $100 and “start making money that day.” He then solicits contact from viewers who want to learn more, reports that he is receiving leads and building a team, and offers to teach them how to do it. The on-screen messages “REAL OPPORTUNITY,” “BRING REAL LEADS,” and “ASK HOW,” together with displayed lead counts, reinforce a recruitment-driven pitch for participation. The description further directs viewers to a Build With Derrick URL identified as the MTI homepage. While the ownership, contents, and behavior of that URL are not established, the promises of prompt returns after contributing money and the accompanying recruitment solicitation establish the investment-pool promotion at issue.
